provenance.recipe: spherically averaged, spin-polarized free atom, Hund's rule within each l (Lehtola configuration table); H-Kr
provenance.note: Computed directly in pyscf (not mqc's Fortran/libxc build) using the identical recipe mqc's own tools/spherical_atom/spherical_atom_reference.py and tools/hirshfeld/hirshfeld_reference.py use as their cross-check; mqc's mqc_czt_hirshfeld.f90 records that its grid-level-7 Fortran result agrees with this exact pyscf recipe to 2e-11 hartree.
